# Lead Lab architecture
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Lead Lab is a Laravel 13 modular monolith with an Inertia React and TypeScript interface. This is the current-design reference for that Option B web application; it documents implemented behavior and recorded product decisions, not launch readiness. `application/source/composer.json:10-17`, `application/source/package.json:29-31`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:112-123`

## Authority hierarchy

1. Approved scope baseline and approved governance records, including `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md`.
2. Workspace conventions and security baseline.
3. Current application source under `application/source/`.
4. This documentation set and the user documentation in `docs/`.

When sources disagree, the lower source must be corrected or the disagreement recorded below. `workspace/AGENTS.md:18-39`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:125-134`

## Documentation boundaries

| Material | Location | Boundary rule |
|---|---|---|
| Current system design | This directory | Explains current behavior with source anchors. |
| User guidance | `../README.md` and its linked pages | Explains how to use the implemented portal; it does not define architecture. |
| Product scope and launch gates | `../../artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md` | Authority for committed product boundary and acceptance. |
| Workflow and technical conventions | `../../workspace/` | Authority for delivery rules and operational constraints. |
| Cycle and project history | `../../application/runs/`, `../../pm-control/`, and `../../project-statrep/` | Link to history; do not repeat incident narratives here. |
| Vocabulary | `../../CONCEPTS.md` | Use these project terms exactly. |

## Maintenance

| Change | Touch | Also check |
|---|---|---|
| Approved decision changes a value, rule, or term | `design-decisions.md` | Record the approved decision first; update linked user guidance if behavior changes. |
| Access, session, or reminder lifecycle changes | `state-machine.md` | `system-overview.md`, `mechanisms.md`, and tests. |
| Data model or security boundary changes | `data-and-security.md` | `design-decisions.md`, migrations, and the security baseline. |
| New user flow or command lands | `system-overview.md` and `mechanisms.md` | Add or update the matching Diataxis page. |
| Operations change | `mechanisms.md` | `application/ops/` and launch evidence. |

Every file has a `verified` frontmatter date. Re-check all cited anchors and update that date when the relevant source changes.
